name: EE Calc
author: conree
description: Electronics bench calculator in the bar: nearest E-series values with part numbers, voltage dividers, SMD codes and colour bands, LED resistors, Ohm's law, and RC and LC.

barWidget.description: E-series values, dividers, resistor codes, LED, Ohm's law, RC and LC

schema.label: Series
schema.description: Series used for two-resistor combinations and divider design.

schema.label: Opens on
schema.description: The calculator the panel opens on. Updated to the last one you used.

schema.label: Package
schema.description: Resistor package for part numbers and the power check.

schema.label: Tolerance
schema.description: Tolerance in percent for part numbers. 5 % parts come in E24 values only. 0.1 % and 0.5 % parts are thin film, in 0402 to 1206 only.

schema.label: Font
schema.description: Font family for the panel. Falls back to the shell font when it is blank or not installed.
